# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# Two lists rather than a dropdown, and not by preference: CMF handles a dropdown
# option click through `CMM_MarkDropdownSelection_<index>` and defines exactly
# twenty of them, so the twenty-first option onwards renders, scrolls, and
# silently keeps the old selection.
#
# One answer across both lists. Ticking a second row anywhere leaves two ticks
# standing for the instant between the click and the callback; the tick that is
# not the stored answer wins and everything else is forced off, so the tick
# visibly moves to one row and stays there.

# Read both lists and settle on one good.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_read_good = {
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tick_count value = 0 }
	cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__good_raw field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_good_raw_ticks }
	every_in_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_good_raw_ticks
		root = { change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tick_count add = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:clay } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 1 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:coal } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 2 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 2 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:cotton } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 3 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 3 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:dyes } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 4 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 4 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:fiber_crops } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 5 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 5 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:fish } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 6 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 6 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:fruit } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 7 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 7 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:horses } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 8 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 8 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:incense } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 9 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 9 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:iron } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 10 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 10 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:ivory } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 11 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 11 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:livestock } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 12 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 12 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:lumber } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 13 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 13 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:medicaments } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 14 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 14 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:salt } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 15 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 15 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:saltpeter } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 16 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 16 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:sand } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 17 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 17 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:silk } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 18 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 18 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:silver } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 19 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 19 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:stone } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 20 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 20 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:sugar } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 21 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 21 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:tobacco } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 22 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 22 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:wild_game } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 23 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 23 } } } }

		if = { limit = { this = goods:wool } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 25 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 25 } } } }
	}
	cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__good_made field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_good_made_ticks }
	every_in_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_good_made_ticks
		root = { change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tick_count add = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:beer } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 26 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 26 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:books } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 27 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 27 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:cannons } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 28 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 28 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:cloth } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 29 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 29 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:fine_cloth } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 30 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 30 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:firearms } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 31 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 31 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:furniture } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 32 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 32 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:glass } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 33 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 33 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:jewelry } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 34 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 34 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:lacquerware } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 35 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 35 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:leather } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 36 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 36 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:liquor } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 37 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 37 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:masonry } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 38 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 38 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:naval_supplies } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 39 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 39 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:paper } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 40 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 40 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:porcelain } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 41 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 41 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:pottery } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 42 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 42 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:slaves_goods } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 43 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 43 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:steel } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 44 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 44 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:tar } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 45 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 45 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:tools } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 46 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 46 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = goods:weaponry } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 47 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_new value = 47 } } } }
	}

	# A tick that is not the stored answer is the new answer. Nothing new ticked
	# means the player unticked the old one, and the answer goes with it.
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_new > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = var:bag_wtp_good_new }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_tick_count = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good_index value = 0 }
	}

	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:clay } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:coal } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 3 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:cotton } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 4 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:dyes } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 5 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:fiber_crops } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 6 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:fish } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 7 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:fruit } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 8 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:horses } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 9 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:incense } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_good_index = 10 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_good value = goods:iron } }
